answer_2.quote: We also measure the average BLEU and ROUGE scores of the simulator's first prompt compared to the real user's first prompt...We compute mean accuracies per dataset and also report correlation and mean absolute error (MAE) between simulator‑AI vs. user‑AI accuracies.
